verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents multi-currency wallet settlement that avoids FX fees via like-for-like settlement (docs-11), the Multi-Currency Pricing API to charge shoppers in local currencies with local payment methods (docs-16), 160+ local payment methods for invoicing (docs-14), and global transfers/payouts to settle funds (docs-12) — directly matching the founder story of charging locally and settling in their own currency with transparent FX. Missing for 10: explicit third-party/independent verification of actual FX rates charged or fee transparency claims, and no direct doc citation on exact conversion margin disclosure.
